en: Black‑and‑white view of a large castle or palace complex built on a high stone bastion above a wooded slope. A long façade with many rectangular windows runs along the right side, while to the left a taller section has a steep mansard-style roof topped with a decorative cupola and weather vane. A stone terrace with iron railings follows the edge of the fortification wall, leading toward the buildings. The image has wide white margins typical of vintage postcard prints. No visible printed text or caption appears on the front.
